description: This file is the minified source of Bootstrap v3.3.5, a popular front-end toolkit for developing responsive web interfaces. It contains JavaScript code that manages UI components such as alerts, buttons, carousels, modals, tooltips, popovers, scrollspy, tabs, and affix behavior, all minified for production use.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates the end of a CSS transition after a specified duration to ensure callbacks execute even if transitionend event doesn't fire.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Handles alert component behavior, including dismissing alerts.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Controls button state changes, such as toggling loading state.

methods.name: carousel
methods.description: Manages the behavior of Bootstrap carousels, including cycling and slide transitions.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Enables show/hide toggle behavior for collapsible elements.

methods.name: dropdown
methods.description: Manages dropdown toggle, keyboard navigation, and opening/closing behavior.

methods.name: modal
methods.description: Controls showing/hiding modal dialogs, including backdrop management and focus enforcement.

methods.name: tooltip
methods.description: Initializes and manages tooltip display with positioning, showing, hiding, and content handling.

methods.name: popover
methods.description: Similar to tooltip, but handles popover components with more complex content.

methods.name: scrollspy
methods.description: Updates navigation state based on scroll position, highlighting active sections.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Handles tab navigation, including activation and transition.

methods.name: affix
methods.description: Allows elements to become fixed (affixed) on scrolling past a certain point.
